## free-tier-llm-landscape
- **What matters:** Any reduction in monthly token caps, removal of specific model endpoints, or new usage‑policy restrictions on Groq, Together, OpenRouter, Google Gemini, or Hugging Face.  
- **Why it matters:** Our autonomous agents rely on uninterrupted access to these free tiers; a tighter quota or a disallowed model can cause sudden failures or degraded performance.  
- **One thing worth verifying:** Check the current free‑tier dashboards or recent provider announcements for each service to confirm token limits, available models, and any newly imposed “commercial‑use” clauses.

## agent-safety-practice
- **What matters:** Layered approval (human‑in‑the‑loop for code execution), sandboxed runtimes (e.g., container or VM isolation), prompt‑injection filters, and immutable audit logs.  
- **Why it matters:** Autonomous coding agents can generate harmful or costly code; safeguards prevent runaway execution, data leakage, and compliance breaches while keeping the system auditable.
